paragraphs: Leo came to Lily's house on Saturday morning. He brought a box of blocks and a toy golf club. Leo was excited about the golf club. "Let's be a team," said Lily. "We can build a very tall tower." They built it on the living room table. The tower had red, blue, and yellow blocks. Soon the tower was taller than Leo. Dad sat on the sofa next to the table. He was using his laptop.

Pip was awake now, and he watched the tower. "Don't touch it, Pip," said Lily. "Be careful, Leo," said Dad, but he did not look up. Leo took the small blue club and the white ball from the box. He put the ball on the floor and hit it too hard. The ball went fast across the floor. It went straight to the table and to Dad on the sofa. Pip jumped up.

"Oh no!" said Lily. "What will happen to the tower?" "And what will happen to Dad's laptop?" Look at the pictures. What do you think happens next? Does the ball hit the table? Does Pip stop it? Guess before you read the next part.

Pip ran after the ball and put his foot on it. The ball stopped next to the table. The tower moved, but it did not fall. Lily gave Pip a big hug. Dad looked up and smiled. "Good dog, Pip," he said. Leo said sorry to Dad, and Dad laughed. "Let's play golf in the garden," said Leo. The tall tower stayed on the table. Pip was the best player on the team.
text.summary: Lily and Leo build a tall tower, and then Leo hits a toy golf ball too hard. It rolls toward the tower and Dad's laptop. What happens next?
